initial_candidates.title: All 14 post-trade control breaches closed with approval; no gaps or overrides
initial_candidates.claim: The breaches log shows 14 breaches between 2025-07-11 and 2026-05-18, all closed with approval (approval_gaps=0, gap_share=0.0) and no overrides (override_patterns produced 0 flags). Closure times averaged 1.5 days with max 2 days, and no breaches exceeded 2 days. This indicates consistent control execution and timely resolution.

evidence.quote: All rows show status closed, approval populated, override_by null

analysis_performed: Checked approval column for nulls across all 14 rows
Checked override_by column for non-null values
alternative_explanations: Approval field may be auto-populated without independent review
Override field may not capture all manual overrides if logged elsewhere
initial_candidates.recommendation: No action required; continue monitoring approval completeness.

initial_candidates.title: No repeated breaches or tight recurrence clusters detected across products
initial_candidates.claim: The repeated-breach screen found 0 repeat products and 0 flags. Product recurrence counts show only MOCK_PTF_ATLAS and MOCK_PTF_BOREAL each had 2 occurrences, but these were separated by months (ATLAS: 2025-07-11 and 2026-04-23; BOREAL: 2025-08-05 and 2026-05-18), not tight clusters. No product showed a pattern of frequent recurrence.

evidence.quote: ATLAS occurrences 2, first 2025-07-11 last 2026-04-23; BOREAL occurrences 2, first 2025-08-05 last 2026-05-18

alternative_explanations: Two occurrences per product may still indicate a slow-burning issue not flagged by cluster logic
Low overall breach volume limits statistical power
initial_candidates.recommendation: No action required; monitor ATLAS and BOREAL for future recurrences.

initial_candidates.title: Resolution times stable with no slow-resolution trend; all breaches closed within 2 days
initial_candidates.claim: Resolution time analysis shows mean closure of 1.5 days, max 2 days, and 0 breaches beyond T+2. The trend slope is 0.015 with R²=0.015, indicating no material upward trend in resolution times. All 14 breaches were resolved promptly.
analysis_performed: Computed mean and max closure days
Fit linear trend to closure days over time
alternative_explanations: Small sample size may hide occasional slow resolutions
Closure days may not capture full remediation time
initial_candidates.recommendation: No action required; continue tracking resolution times.

initial_candidates.title: Severity mix shifted toward low-severity breaches in second half; no medium-severity escalation
initial_candidates.claim: Severity comparison shows low-severity share increased from 71.4% to 85.7% (shift +0.14) and medium-severity share decreased from 28.6% to 14.3% (shift -0.14) between the first half (2025-07-11..2025-12-02) and second half (2025-12-25..2026-05-18). This suggests a shift toward less severe breaches, but the small sample (14 total) limits confidence.

evidence.quote: low first_half_share 0.7143 second_half_share 0.8571 shift 0.1429; medium first_half_share 0.2857 second_half_share 0.1429 shift -0.1429

analysis_performed: Split breaches into two halves by date
alternative_explanations: Random variation due to small sample
Change in product mix or market conditions
initial_candidates.recommendation: No action required; monitor severity mix in future reviews.

initial_candidates.title: Research execution limit prevented direct SQL verification; deterministic results used
initial_candidates.claim: The research summary indicates a ToolException: DuckDB query failed because schema 'post_trade_controls' does not exist, so direct SQL verification of the breaches table was not possible. All findings rely on the provided deterministic analysis results and the material summary preview, which are internally consistent. This gap should be disclosed.

evidence.quote: ToolException: DuckDB query failed: Catalog Error: Table with name 'post_trade_controls.breaches' does not exist

analysis_performed: Fell back to deterministic analysis results
alternative_explanations: Schema naming mismatch in the research environment
Temporary unavailability of the table
initial_candidates.recommendation: Re-run verification with corrected schema path or use provided deterministic outputs as authoritative.
